pary-p01-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p01-v01.question: What speech is studied?
premises: Filled with rest of beginning-end-entered endless power — unspeakable —
I study speech: the Lord's heart.
pary-p01-v01.inference: Unspeakable rest-filled speech studied as Lord's heart.

pary-p01-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p01-v02.question: Whose made are gods?
premises: He indeed Bhairava god; all gods of-whom-made.
That very Bhairavī — being, non-being too — of-whom-made.

pary-p01-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p01-v03.question: What is Bhairava-doctrine, and its opponent?
premises: That indeed Bhairava's knowledge-ignorance too of-whom-made.
He indeed Bhairava-doctrine — opponent too of-whom-made.

pary-p01-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p01-v04.question: Where is the goal past speech?
premises: Unity of six paths — where that Bhairavī abides — at the end of all systems —
Ineffable, supreme goal.
pary-p01-v04.inference: Six-pathed unity, system-end abode, ineffable goal.

pary-p01-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p01-v05.question: What ground is undivided?
premises: She — bliss-only-self-merged will-knowledge-true-action —
Heart of god-of-gods, of Bhairava, undivided ground.

pary-p01-v06.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p01-v06.question: How does the Lord reach stages?
premises: From consciousness-nature, that god by own self reflecting — Lord, from unattached to stage-ends — stages attains.

pary-p01-v07.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p01-v07.question: How is the sixfold path expressed?
premises: There expressive, expressed, self — of two vibrations singly —
Of Lord gross, subtle, supreme appearance — of sequences sixfold path.
pary-p01-v07.inference: Expressed self of vibrations; sixfold path of sequences.

pary-p02-v08.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v08.question: What varied-shines for the knower?
premises: Sequence which space-time-self, difference-life — of knowings from separation —
This of-knower makes-varied-appearance.

pary-p02-v09.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v09.question: Where does purity dive?
premises: Of both — there indeed way: pure, impure, self — from difference —
Purity of externalized objects — in I-ness immersion.
pary-p02-v09.inference: Pure-impure wayed; object-purity dived in I-ness.

pary-p02-v10.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v10.question: What states stand between?
premises: Impurity too of immersed — not thus heart-rest — in-between too infinite are states by-degrees.
pary-p02-v10.inference: Immersed-impure unresting; infinite states by degrees between.

pary-p02-v11.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v11.question: How divide subject-object?
premises: Of proper-measured knowers in manifestation — common; otherwise-states divided —
Subject of-object.

pary-p02-v12.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v12.question: What creation holds unthought?
premises: Thought-free, clear appearance — that creation of Shambhu held —
By non-difference, in self-creation, own-self indeed made-instrument.
pary-p02-v12.inference: Unthought-clear creation held; self instrumented in self-making.

pary-p02-v13.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v13.question: What threads difference into powers?
premises: Action, knowledge, self, consciousness, power — from difference-threading-cause —
Kalā, vidyā, stage reached — in difference-undifference again becomes.
pary-p02-v13.inference: Five thread difference-cause; kalā-vidyā reached, re-becoming.

pary-p02-v14.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p02-v14.question: When is effort cut and uncut?
premises: Means-of-knowledge, intellect, multitudes — which of action imaginations —
That indeed cut, cut — action, knowledge, effort — when.

pary-p03-v15.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p03-v15.question: When is the bound soul called?
premises: Action-intellect-limited obtained — then that bound soul called.
Thus by will He, blessed Bhairava, is measured.
pary-p03-v15.inference: Limited obtained called bound; willed measured Bhairava.

pary-p03-v16.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p03-v16.question: What stations follow power?
premises: Limited-function being — that power follows him.
His Vidyeśa, Sadākhya, Śivahood — from contracted state: body, breath, intellect, void, knowership attained.
pary-p03-v16.inference: Limited follows; stations attained from contracted state.

pary-p03-v17.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p03-v17.question: What imagination purifies?
premises: His particular creation — that-and-that various imagination — Śaiva creation arisen —
Impression of purified dependent-on-that.
pary-p03-v17.inference: Particular imaginations arisen; purified impression dependent.

pary-p03-v18.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p03-v18.question: How abide undistracted?
premises: Knower indeed — this of-such-kind — at festival-of-limitation undistracted abides —
In own self, without thought, consciousness-self.
pary-p03-v18.inference: Such-kind knower abides undistracted in thought-free self.

pary-p03-v19.speaker: Abhinavagupta (addressing pupil)
pary-p03-v19.question: Child, see what as nondual?
premises: Child, see — you indeed this as-nondual — of consciousness known, of-that-made world —
Other trivial unreal — because.
pary-p03-v19.inference: Behold nondual known world; other trivial unreal.

pary-p03-v20.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p03-v20.question: What means needs no other?
premises: What means this principle — from which other not indeed possible —
Without-other-means — this self-means — called.

pary-p04-v21.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v21.question: How attain direct self-knowing?
premises: Having withdrawn from all thought — I thus cultivating thought-free own-consciousness direct attains.

pary-p04-v22.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v22.question: What vow in acceptance?
premises: Infinite, such-formed, in acceptance even, one-character — that own-consciousness entered —
Thoughts not should-imagine.
pary-p04-v22.inference: Infinite-formed acceptance entered; thoughts unimagned vowed.

pary-p04-v23.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v23.question: How dive sky-goddess lakes?
premises: Khecarī-etc., four-streams, flow, full, great-lakes — sky-goddess, self-consciousness —
Having dived, should-agitate inert.

pary-p04-v24.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v24.question: How trust five-doing Śiva?
premises: Creation, keeping, loosing, veiling, grace — by sequence, five-doing —
Śiva I — thus should-trust.

pary-p04-v25.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v25.question: How become accomplished considering?
premises: By projection-knowledge-counting guru's-word, those in self considered — accomplished becomes.

pary-p04-v26.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v26.question: How imagine fire-flames?
premises: Having imagined world-self Bhairava I — mine indeed those world-modes —
As fire's flame-modes, sun's radiance.

pary-p04-v27.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p04-v27.question: How measure measurer-measured?
premises: One I measurer, knowing, measure, measured, having-kinds — pure-knowledge-etc. by-form —
Khecarī-etc. fourteen.

pary-p05-v28.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v28.question: How go in trust?
premises: By measured-unmeasured mode, bondage-liberation contemplating — Bhairava I am —
Thus by trust supreme freedom should go.
pary-p05-v28.inference: Contemplating measured-unmeasured, trust supreme freedom's going.

pary-p05-v29.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v29.question: What holds timelessly?
premises: Inner action, outer action, timeless sequence of self independent held —
Which You full-of-Lord's-power.

pary-p05-v30.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v30.question: What pairs in union?
premises: Supreme emission, self, rest, rise, pair, union of Śiva-and-Śakti —
Between them — and other powers.
pary-p05-v30.inference: Supreme pair unioned; other powers between.

pary-p05-v31.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v31.question: How is bliss indistinct?
premises: Bliss, will, lordship, opening, deficiency — and lordship of will indistinct, distinct by difference —
Manifestation of known of those two of knowers.

pary-p05-v32.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v32.question: What feeling lives the knowns?
premises: Bliss by supreme-two, and junction — then feeling of knowns, life-principle —
Thus full that Bhairava body.

pary-p05-v33.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p05-v33.question: How abide grossly to fivefold?
premises: Known-flashing this in will, in lordship — and from one side abiding —
By grossness earth etc. element fivefoldness may-go.

pary-p06-v34.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v34.question: How tenfold by touch?
premises: By subtleness, smell etc. five subtle-elements — then by instrumentality from touch —
Of senses tenfoldness.
pary-p06-v34.inference: Subtle-five instrumented by touch into ten.

pary-p06-v35.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v35.question: What depends on what?
premises: Of knowability by covering, subjecthood manifestation in sequence —
Mind I-intellect-hood of these in non-differentiation predominance, personhood —
And contraction expansion which in-dependence.

pary-p06-v36.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v36.question: Whence arose union?
premises: Arose desired from union, from double-form, of-both-self, from will-nature, from opening —
Otherwise supreme from union.
pary-p06-v36.inference: Desired union arose; otherwise supreme thence.

pary-p06-v37.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v37.question: Who bears triśaṅku-like?
premises: Four powers inner of spirit, his inside, supporters —
Of consciousness-space, of inert-ground, of Māyā-made — like Triśaṅku.
pary-p06-v37.inference: Four bear inside triśaṅku-like between knowing and inert.

pary-p06-v38.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v38.question: What emission creates widely?
premises: Of will-power of-three-form, three other powers became — emission this —
Then exceedingly clear became, created from expansion.
pary-p06-v38.inference: Three became emission, then clear-created widely.

pary-p06-v39.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p06-v39.question: What mixing makes unagitated?
premises: This having-created of self-powers mutual from-mixing may-become agitation —
Inner not from-this emission outside may-become.
pary-p06-v39.inference: Self-powers mixed unagitating; emission kept within.

pary-p07-v40.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v40.question: How is the emitted rested?
premises: So-much all being will etc. by-door supreme in-Bhairava rested-rested —
Again from-that indeed emitted.

pary-p07-v41.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v41.question: What hidden reflection speaks pure?
premises: Inner-hidden infinite meaning own-self reflection consciousness supreme —
One-time from-flow which this mantra-knowing speech pure agency.
pary-p07-v41.inference: Hidden reflection speaks pure agency mantra-knowing.

pary-p07-v42.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v42.question: What time draws itself?
premises: Three-flow three-path three-placed time — that draws by-itself outside —
Then and in-self — thus glorious-supreme time-drawer.
pary-p07-v42.inference: Triple time self-drawn outside, self-drawn within.

pary-p07-v43.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p07-v43.question: What beholding rests on the Lord?
premises: Divided inner-made undivided state observation higher-lower —
Agency that indeed seeing — his indeed lord state based.
pary-p07-v43.inference: Divided-unified beheld; agency seeing rests lord-based.
uncertainties: ākha.ṅda print kept; īśa short stem kept.

pary-p07-v44.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v44.question: How differentiated inwardly?
premises: Middle with-sequence gross in-inner-organ imagination undivided expressed —
Prana-function differentiated.

pary-p07-v45.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v45.question: How is Māyā's measure limited?
premises: Own-impression from-such-state of-two-states of-previous also —
Māyā of-measure limitedness may-be of-seeing — and sequence indeed subtle.

pary-p07-v46.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p07-v46.question: Who enters blessed expanding?
premises: Of-those-two having-entered of-states by-sequence quiet of-thoughts —
Blessed own-consciousness expansion wonderfully perceives.

pary-p08-v47.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p08-v47.question: What sounds are heard?
premises: That place instrument strike spirit activity nature being —
Vaikharī functions whose these these audible.

pary-p08-v48.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p08-v48.question: How is usage exchanged?
premises: By-these mutually knowledge transmission self — that worldly usage —
Then scriptural various contraction narrow.
pary-p08-v48.inference: Mutually transmitted; worldly then scriptural, contracted various.

pary-p08-v49.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p08-v49.question: Who unenjoying in waking?
premises: Thus pervasion-of-speech knowing this group presiding-deities —
Maheśvarī headed goddesses in-waking even not enjoy.

pary-p08-v50.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
pary-p08-v50.question: What all-means enters self-knowing?
premises: By-means non-grasping to-be-done to-be-attained Bhairavī-state —
Which that own-consciousness that indeed all-means should-enter.

pary-p08-v51.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
pary-p08-v51.question: What mystery attained unsurpassed?
premises: Beginning-end inner infinite expressed expressive full secret of-mantras-and-mudrās —
I-attain unsurpassed greatness.

pary-p08-v52.speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice, closing)
pary-p08-v52.question: Who conquers unfallen?
premises: Of-Shambhu undivided hearts victorious gurus formerly —
Without-rising absorption obtained end prosperity.

pary-p01-v01.plain_english: Filled with rest of beginning-end-entered endless power — unspeakable — I study speech: the Lord's heart.
pary-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām anuccāryām | ahaṃ vācam adhīye hṛdayaṃ vibhoḥ

pary-p01-v02.plain_english: He indeed Bhairava god; all gods of-whom-made. That very Bhairavī — being, non-being too — of-whom-made.
pary-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devas sarve devāś ca yanmayāḥ | saivāsau bhairavī sattāsattāpi ca yanmayī

pary-p01-v03.plain_english: That indeed Bhairava's knowledge-ignorance too of-whom-made. He indeed Bhairava-doctrine — opponent too of-whom-made.
pary-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: tad eva bhairavaṃ jñānam ajñānam api yanmayam | sa hi bhairavasiddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣo 'pi yanmayaḥ

pary-p01-v04.plain_english: Unity of six paths — where that Bhairavī abides — at the end of all systems — ineffable, supreme goal.
pary-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: aikadhyam adhvanāṃ ṣa.ṅnāṃ yatra sā bhairavī sthitiḥ | paryante sarvatantrāṇām avācyā paramā gatiḥ

pary-p01-v05.plain_english: She — bliss-only-self-merged will-knowledge-true-action — heart of god-of-gods, of Bhairava, undivided ground.

pary-p01-v06.plain_english: From nature of consciousness, that god by own self reflecting — Lord, from unattached to end-of-stages — stages attains.
pary-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: citsvābhāvyād asau devaḥ svātmanā vimṛṣan prabhuḥ | anāśritādibhūmyantā bhūmikāḥ pratipadyate

The sthāyibhāva is wonder: triple-coursed, self-drawn. Drawing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: split, whole, beheld, standing. Beholding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: sequenced, fancied undivided, split. Splitting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: stamped, measured, subtle. Measuring relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: entered, stilled, wonder-seen. Perceiving relished.

essence: Place-struck natured being; heard Vaikharī doings.

sections.SUMMARY: Place-means-shocked spirited natured being; Vaikharī doings heard. Handed mutual knowing; common then bookish, straitened narrow. Speech-spread knowing host goddesses Maheśvarī-led unenjoying even waking. Way ungrasping to-do-to-gain Bhairavī-standing; own-knowing all-ways entered. Beginning-end-inner-boundless said-saying-full mystery of chant-seal attained unsurpassed. Shambhu's undivided hearts conquer of old, riseless-absorbed, end-endowed.

rasa.dominant: nāda-vīra of heard doings; vīra of straitened exchange; karuṇa-adbhuta of unenjoying goddesses; vīra of all-ways entering; vīra of attained mystery; jaya-śānta of conquering close
rasa.sthayibhava: nādotsāha at struck-heard; utsāha at handed-narrowed; karuṇā-vismaya at waking-unenjoyed; utsāha at ungrasping-entered; utsāha at brimming-attained; jaya-śama at undivided-conquering
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: struck, natured, heard. Sounding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: handed each-to-each, straitened. Exchanging relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-wonder: spread knowing, unenjoying waking. Unenjoying relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: ungrasping way, all-ways entered. Entering relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: full, mystery, attained. Attaining relished. The sthāyibhāva is victory-peace: undivided, conquering, endowed. Closing relished.

Śiva I — so trust.
pary-p04-v24.sanskrit_cite: sargasthāpanasaṃhāranigrahānugrahakramāt pañcakṛtyāni | kurvāṇaḥ śivo 'ham iti viśvaset

lines: By cast-knowing-counted order, guru-mouthed —
those weighed in self — done, accomplished.
pary-p04-v25.sanskrit_cite: kṣepajñānaprasaṃkhyā[naga]tinādakrameṇa vā guruvaktreṇa | tāny ātmany ākalayya kṛtī bhavet

lines: Dreamt up — world-self Bhairava I — mine indeed those world-shapes —
as fire's flame-shapes, sun's shine.
pary-p04-v26.sanskrit_cite: vikalpayitvā viśvātmā bhairavo 'haṃ mamaiva tāḥ | viśvabhaṅgyo yathā vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ

lines: One I — measurer, measuring, measure, measured — kinded —
pure-knowing-formed — sky-goers fourteen.
By measured and unmeasured modes — bondage, freedom — contemplating —
Bhairava I am — so in trust supreme freedom should go.
pary-p05-v28.sanskrit_cite: medāmedaprakāreṇa bandhamokṣau vibhāvayan bhairavo 'smīti visrambhāt svācchandyaṃ paramaṃ vrajet

lines: Inward deed, outward deed — timeless, self's own sequence held —
which You — Lord-power-full.
pary-p05-v29.sanskrit_cite: antaḥkārabahiṣkārāv akālakramam ātmanaḥ aparādhīnam ādhatse yat tvaṃ prābhavanirbharaḥ

lines: Supreme outpour, self, rest, rise, pair — Śiva-Shakti's union —
between, and other powers.
Bliss, will, lordship, opening, lack — and will's lordship
vague, clear, by difference — known flashing for the two who know.
pary-p05-v31.sanskrit_cite: ānandeccheśanonmeṣā ūnatā ceśanecchayoḥ asphuṭasphuṭabhedena vedyollāsas tayor vidaḥ

lines: Bliss by the two supreme, and joining — then knowns' feeling, life itself —
so full, that Bhairava-body.
pary-p05-v32.sanskrit_cite: ānandānuttarābhyāṃ ca sandhībhāvo 'tha vedanā vedyānāṃ prāṇabhūteti pūrṇaṃ tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

lines: Known-flashing here in will, in lordship — one-sided abiding —
by grossness earth-first elements may go five.
pary-p05-v33.sanskrit_cite: vedyollāso 'yam icchāyām īśane caikataḥ sthitaḥ sthūlatvena pṛthivyādibhūtapañcakatām iyāt

lines: By fineness — smell-first five subtle-stuffs —
then tooled by touch — senses ten.
pary-p06-v34.sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmatvena ca gandhādipañcatanmātratāṃ tataḥ karaṇatvena saṃsparśād indriyāṇāṃ dvipañcatām

lines: Knowable veiled — knower shown in sequence —
mind's I-sense of these, undivided, first — personhood — and ebb and flow as they depend.
pary-p06-v35.sanskrit_cite: vedyatāyāḥ chādanena vettṛtodbhāsanakrame mano 'haṃbuddhitāṃ eṣām avibhāge pradhānatām puruṣatvaṃ ca saṃkocavikāsau yadapekṣayā

lines: It arose — longed-from joining, double-formed, both-selved,
will-natured, opening — else supreme from joining.
pary-p06-v36.sanskrit_cite: abhūvann iṣyasaṃyogād dvirūpād ubhayātmanaḥ icchāsvarūpād unmeṣād anyathānuttarāyutāt

lines: Four powers, inward, of his spirit — inside bearing —
knowing-space, inert-ground, Māyā-made — hung like Triśaṅku.
pary-p06-v37.sanskrit_cite: catasraś śaktyo 'ntaḥsthāḥ puṃso 'syāntaś ca dhārikāḥ cidvyomno jaḍabhūmeś ca māyāmayyas triśaṅkuvat

lines: Will-power's three-formed — three more powers became —
emission here — then stark clear became, spread-created.
pary-p06-v38.sanskrit_cite: icchāśaktes trirūpāyās tisro 'nyāś śaktyo 'bhavan visargo 'yam athātyarthaṃ sphuṭo 'bhūt sṛjyavistarāt

lines: This — self-powers made, mixed each-with-each — may stir —
within, not from this outpour outside, may it be.
pary-p06-v39.sanskrit_cite: etat sṛṣṭvātmaśaktīnām itaretaramiśrāt bhavet kṣobhāntaraṃ nāsmād visargād bāhyato bhavet

lines: So much — all being, will-led, by every door — supreme, in Bhairava rested, rested —
then emitted indeed.
pary-p07-v40.sanskrit_cite: iyatsarvaṃ sad icchādidvārānuttarabhairave viśramya viśramya muhus tata eva visṛjyate

lines: Hid within — boundless sense, own-self's mirror — knowing supreme —
once, from the flood — this mantra-knowing speech, pure in act.
pary-p07-v41.sanskrit_cite: antarnilīnānantārthasvātmāmarśaś citiḥ parā ekavāravahād yeyaṃ mantrī vāk śuddhakartṛtā

lines: Triple-coursed, triple-pathed, triple-seated time —
she draws herself, outside — then in self — glorious supreme time-drawer.
pary-p07-v42.sanskrit_cite: trivahaṃ tripathaṃ tristhaṃ kālaṃ sā karṣati svataḥ bahis tataś cātmanīti śrīparā kālakarṣiṇī

lines: Split, inward-made whole — beholding higher-lower —
agency itself seeing — his, the Lord's state-standing.
pary-p07-v43.sanskrit_cite: bheditāntaḥkṛtākha.ṅdabhāvāvekṣā parāparā kartṛtā saiva paśyantī tasyaiveśadaśāśrayā

lines: Middle, sequenced, gross — inward-organed, fancied undivided, said —
breath-work split.
pary-p07-v44.sanskrit_cite: madhyamā sakramā sthūlā antaḥkaraṇavartinī vikalpanābhinnavācyā prāṇavṛttivibheditā

lines: Self-stamped from such a state — two states gone before, too —
Māyā-measured, limits may see — and sequence, fine indeed.
pary-p07-v45.sanskrit_cite: svavāsanātādavasthyād daśayoḥ pūrvayor api māyāmātur mitatvaṃ syāt paśyantyāś ca kramo hy aṇuḥ

lines: Of the two — entered, states sequenced, thoughts stilled —
blessed own-knowing's expanse wonders to see.
pary-p07-v46.sanskrit_cite: tayor āviśya daśayoḥ kramāc chāntavikalpayoḥ dhanyas svasaṃvidvistāraṃ sāścaryam anupaśyati

lines: That — place, means, shock — spirited working, natured, being —
Vaikharī's doings — whose are these, these heard.
pary-p08-v47.sanskrit_cite: sā sthānakaraṇāghātapuṃvyāpārātmikā satī vaikharī vṛttayo yasyāstā imāḥ śrutigocarāḥ

lines: By these, each-to-each, knowing handed — self —
that common use — then bookish, sundry, strait, narrow.
pary-p08-v48.sanskrit_cite: ābhiḥ parasparaṃ jñānasaṃkrāntyātmā sa laukikaḥ vyavahāro 'tha śāstrīyo nānāsaṃkocasaṃkaṭaḥ

lines: So speech-spread knowing this host, gods-over —
Maheśvarī-led goddesses — waking even, unenjoying.
pary-p08-v49.sanskrit_cite: iti vāgvyāptividvāṃsam etadvargādhidevatāḥ māheśvarīmukhā devyo jāgare 'pi na bhuñjate

lines: By a way ungrasping — to-do, to-gain, Bhairavī-standing —
which, that own-knowing — all ways — should enter.
pary-p08-v50.sanskrit_cite: upāyenāgrahaḥ kārya upeyā bhairavīsthitiḥ yāsau svasaṃvit tām eva sarvopāyāṃ samāviśet

lines: First-last, in-held, boundless — said, saying, brimming —
mystery of chant-and-seal — I reach the unsurpassed glow.
Shambhu's — undivided hearts — conquering gurus of old —
riseless absorption gained — end-prosperity.
